aboutUs.title: Support Spirit of peace and solidarity?
aboutUs.description: Because we know that even the best programs are only as good as the people behind them. That's why we offer comprehensive support, community empowerment, and sustainable solutions that create lasting impact in vulnerable communities across Rwanda.

programsPage.heroDesc: Empowering refugees and host communities through four core programs across the Great Lakes region
programsPage.intro: Founded in 2019 and led by refugees, Spirit of Peace and Solidarity (SPS) designs and implements programs that respond directly to the needs of displaced and at-risk populations. We believe refugees are not passive beneficiaries — they are active agents of change.
programsPage.program1Desc1: At SPS, we believe that education is not a privilege — it is a fundamental right and a powerful tool for change. For refugees and members of the host community, access to quality education and vocational training is a critical bridge to dignity, self-reliance, and long-term peace.
programsPage.program1Desc2: Through this program, SPS is committed to breaking the cycle of dependency by equipping individuals — especially youth and women — with the knowledge, skills, and confidence they need to take control of their futures. We offer inclusive, practical, and transformative learning opportunities that respond to real needs in our communities.
programsPage.program1Desc3: This program is built on the belief that displaced people are not a burden but a resource. With the right support, refugees and marginalized youth can become the innovators, educators, and leaders who will shape a better future for all.
programsPage.program2Desc1: We believe that access to healthcare is a fundamental human right. Yet in many remote and underserved areas — especially where refugees and rural populations live — this right remains far out of reach. Our Health and Wellness program was born from the urgent need to close this gap.
programsPage.program2Desc2: In partnership with local governments and the Ministry of Health, SPS manages both first and second generation health posts in hard-to-reach communities. Our mission is bold and life-saving: to reduce infant mortality, protect mothers, and ensure that no one dies simply because they could not reach a health facility in time.
programsPage.health_approach1: Community-Centered Delivery: We bring services directly to the people in remote and underserved areas, prioritizing refugees and host communities equally.
programsPage.health_approach2: Government Collaboration: We work hand in hand with local authorities and the Ministry of Health to align with national health strategies and ensure sustainability.
programsPage.health_approach3: Health Equity Focus: We prioritize access for pregnant women, children, and other at-risk groups who face barriers to traditional healthcare.
programsPage.health_approach4: Preventive and Curative Services: From vaccinations and prenatal care to health education and chronic disease management, our services are comprehensive.
programsPage.health_approach5: Capacity Building: We train and support local health workers to build strong, resilient health systems that can serve communities in the long term.
programsPage.health_approach6: Empathy in Action: Every intervention is grounded in compassion, aiming not only to treat illness but also to restore dignity and hope.
programsPage.program3Desc1: True empowerment begins with economic independence. In communities affected by displacement and poverty, the ability to earn a stable income is a pathway to dignity, resilience, and lasting peace. Our Economic Empowerment Program is designed to unleash the entrepreneurial potential of refugees and host community members — especially women and youth.
programsPage.program3Desc2: We equip participants with the tools, knowledge, and support needed to build self-sustaining businesses and livelihoods. We don't just offer training — we walk the journey with our beneficiaries from the first spark of an idea to a thriving, market-ready business.
programsPage.econ_approach1: Facilitate access to financial resources, including micro-grants, small loans, and connections to community-based savings groups.
programsPage.econ_approach2: Deliver entrepreneurship and financial literacy training, tailored to the local context, enabling participants to turn ideas into viable business models.
programsPage.econ_approach3: Provide ongoing mentorship and coaching, ensuring that each entrepreneur receives personalized guidance and strategic advice for long-term success.
programsPage.econ_approach4: Link businesses to markets, by supporting product standardization, branding, and value chain development ensuring products are competitive on the open market.
programsPage.econ_approach5: Foster cooperatives and group businesses, encouraging peer-to-peer learning, shared investment, and community-driven sustainability.
programsPage.program3Vision: Our vision is not just to reduce poverty — it is to create a generation of confident, self-reliant entrepreneurs who break the cycle of dependency and lead change from within.
programsPage.program4Title: Social Integration, Peace-building and Humanitarian Aid
programsPage.program4Desc1: SPS promotes social cohesion through dialogue, cultural exchange, and faith-based peace initiatives. We also respond to humanitarian emergencies by providing temporary support to displaced families and advocating for protection, family reunification, and durable solutions.
programsPage.program4Desc2: Founded and led by refugees, SPS is uniquely positioned to address the root causes of division and displacement. We understand, from lived experience, how conflict, discrimination, and exclusion have torn apart communities. Too often, unemployed and marginalized youth are exploited by those who propagate violence and hatred. That is why we stand for peace — not just as a slogan, but as an active, daily commitment.
programsPage.peace_approach1: Community events that celebrate diversity and foster togetherness across refugee and host communities.
programsPage.peace_approach2: Intergenerational and interfaith dialogue sessions that open minds and break down harmful ideologies.
programsPage.peace_approach3: Cultural exchange programs that create opportunities for shared experiences, learning, and trust-building.
programsPage.peace_approach4: Advocacy for the rights and protection of displaced people, including family reunification and resettlement.
programsPage.peace_approach5: Protection of unaccompanied children and other vulnerable groups in emergency situations.
programsPage.ctaDesc: Your support enables SPS to expand its reach across the Great Lakes region and deepen its impact for refugees and host communities.

impactPage.heroDesc: Real results from the ground — stories of lives changed across the Great Lakes region
impactPage.stat4Label: Songs of peace delivered to the Great Lakes region
impactPage.storyTitle: The Birth of Spirit of Peace and Solidarity
impactPage.storyHeading: From Lived Experience to Lasting Change
impactPage.storyP1: Since 2015, following the violation of the Constitution by Burundian authorities, human rights defenders including our founder Melance took a leading role in speaking out against unlawful actions. As a result, they were subjected to severe persecution and threats, forcing them to flee into exile.
impactPage.storyP2: Even while living as a refugee, Melance never remained silent. In 2018, while hospitalized without support, he encountered many other vulnerable individuals facing similar conditions. This experience revealed a painful reality: many people were denied their fundamental rights simply because they lacked care, representation, and solidarity.
impactPage.storyP3: It was during this period that the idea of Spirit of Peace and Solidarity was born. After being discharged from the hospital, Melance formally founded the organization, and its first activities began within the very hospital where he had once been a patient. This moment marked SPS's commitment to standing with the most vulnerable and defending human dignity.
impactPage.impactHealthDesc: Through our Health and Wellness program, SPS manages first and second generation health posts in hard-to-reach communities, reducing infant mortality and ensuring that vulnerable groups — including pregnant women, children, and the elderly — can access care without fear or hardship.
impactPage.impactAidDesc: Our Social Integration and Humanitarian Aid program responds to emergencies by providing temporary support to displaced families — food, shelter, and immediate protection — while advocating for family reunification and durable solutions.
impactPage.impactYouthDesc: Through our Education & Vocational Training and Economic Empowerment programs, 300 youth and women refugees have gained skills, launched businesses, and taken meaningful steps toward self-reliance and economic independence.
impactPage.impactPeace: Songs of Peace to the Great Lakes Region
impactPage.impactPeaceDesc: As part of our peace-building work, SPS has produced 10 songs of peace as cultural tools to bridge divides, celebrate diversity, and promote social cohesion between refugee and host communities across the Great Lakes region.
impactPage.visionText: A society where human rights are equal for all, no one is left behind, and every voice is heard with dignity, protection and respect.
impactPage.missionText: To strengthen advocacy for human rights especially refugees while designing and implementing sustainable projects shaped by community participation and lived experience.
impactPage.ctaDesc: Together, we can create lasting change for refugees and host communities across the Great Lakes region. Every contribution makes a difference.
